analysis:
The PR changes only docs/developer/test.md. The diffs are a 'Last updated' date bump (line 3), a CI shard routing note (head lines 99-101: each provider shard routed through its own lane `test-provider-K`, linking build.md#ci-runner-routing), and a test-description edit near base 1344-1346 / head 1346-1349 (CI routing checks now pin per-shard lanes, matching the job matrix). That last hunk is outside the supplied head text units (lines 1-921), so I could only see it in the patch excerpt.

No runtime code, key handling, attestation, coordinator WebSocket contract, cache storage or authorization behavior changes. I checked the changed text against the threat model assets, boundaries and threats (T-041 cache, TB-011 App Attest, TB-012 add-on hold). The documentation does not weaken or contradict any retained control: it still tells readers to use isolated state, avoid production cache roots/keys, and keep synthetic fixtures separate from live state.

The CI routing text refers to an external routing plane and runner lanes. Those are outside the supplied evidence, so I cannot verify the plane's trust or permission claims (read-only permissions, fallback, timeout, no contact with the real plane). They are recorded as unverified contracts, not findings. Remaining question for integration: whether the CI routing change touches workflow files with secrets or permissions elsewhere in the PR. This doc-only unit shows no new attack surface, and the threat model needs no update from these edits.
